title: Shopify DTC Operations Manager
description:
Ready to build something that truly matters?

Every parent wants clarity, confidence, and connection when it comes to their child’s learning. They want to feel proud of the choices they make and trust the tools they bring into their home. At Hadley Designs, we make that possible by creating products that turn everyday 
nts into meaningful learning experiences.



But none of that works without a seamless, trustworthy customer experience. A store that runs flawlessly. Messaging that is clear. Operations that feel effortless to the customer.



That’s where you come in.



About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is a family-founded, female-led brand redefining early education through creativity, beauty, and connection.



We believe learning should be fun and engaging. We don’t just sell products, we shape futures. Our mission is to create screen-free, hands-on learning tools that build confidence, spark curiosity, and bring families closer together.



Every product we design is rooted in purpose. Beautiful design creates better learning, and every detail matters. From the first click to the 
nt a child lights up with understanding, we are committed to delivering an experience families can trust.



About the Role

DTC Operations Manager

Also known as: Shopify Operations Manager | Ecommerce Operations Lead | Customer Experience Operations Manager



This role is the backbone of our direct-to-consumer experience. You will own the performance, accuracy, and clarity of our Shopify store from end to end.



Your mission is simple and powerful. Ensure every customer fully understands what they are buying and when they will receive it before they complete their purchase.



Your Core Focus

-Take full ownership of Shopify store operations and customer experience

-Eliminate inconsistencies across the site, including broken links, outdated promotions, and conflicting messaging

-Standardize shipping, split shipment, and pre-order communication across all touchpoints

-Build and document SOPs for all operational workflows

-Implement systems and automations that reduce manual work and customer confusion



What You’ll Do



Customer Experience Management (Daily)



-Respond to customer inquiries via Shopify inbox and social channels

-Process refunds, reships, cancellations, and order updates

-Triage and resolve support tickets based on urgency

-Identify patterns in customer feedback and recommend improvements

-Ensure all communication is clear, accurate, and aligned with current messaging



Order Operations and Fulfillment (Daily)



-Monitor order flow across Shopify, Base, and Amazon MCF

-Resolve failed orders, inventory issues, and discrepancies

-Coordinate with fulfillment teams to ensure timely delivery

-Manage split shipments, pre-orders, and out-of-stock scenarios

-Track and resolve missing or delayed packages



Store Integrity and Accuracy (Weekly)



-Audit the website for broken links, incorrect pricing, and outdated promotions

-Ensure consistency across product pages, landing pages, and collections

-Validate all messaging related to shipping and pre-orders

-Support promotion setup and ensure backend accuracy



Systems, SOPs, and Automation (Weekly)



-Build and maintain SOPs for recurring workflows

-Identify inefficiencies and implement automation using tools like Shopify Flow

-Optimize customer service platforms such as Gorgias

-Improve post-purchase experience and operational workflows

-Support system cleanup and tool evaluation



Growth Operations and Reporting (Weekly)



-Deliver weekly Shopify performance reports

-Track key metrics such as CAC, LTV, and funnel performance

-Identify trends, anomalies, and risks early

-Ensure data accuracy for decision-making



Compliance and Risk Management (Weekly)



-Maintain compliance across ADA, privacy policies, and tracking regulations

-Review product pages and campaigns for compliance risks

-Ensure all required tools and disclosures are functioning properly

-Stay updated on platform policies and changes



AI and Automation Ownership (Ongoing)



-Identify repetitive tasks and convert them into automated workflows

-Use AI tools to improve efficiency in customer service and operations

-Build prompt libraries and scalable systems

-Continuously reduce manual workload while maintaining accuracy



How Success Is Measured



-Reduction in support ticket rate per 1000 orders

-Reduction in reshipment rate per 1000 orders

-Zero compliance issues

-At least one new AI automation implemented per week

-Zero reported issues with broken links, incorrect promotions, or inaccurate information



Success looks like a store that runs without chaos. Orders flow cleanly. Customers feel confident. Problems are solved before they scale.



Requirements

Who You Are

You are a systems-driven operator who takes pride in getting the details right.



You think like an owner. You move quickly, solve problems independently, and take full responsibility for outcomes. You don’t wait for direction. You create clarity where others see complexity.



-You have 2 to 5 years of experience managing Shopify store operations

-You are highly detail-oriented and catch inconsistencies others miss

-You are a strong written communicator who can simplify complex information

-You have hands-on experience with order management, fulfillment, and customer service

-You understand Shopify apps, backend systems, and troubleshooting workflows

-You build systems, not just solutions

-You thrive in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

-You are comfortable working cross-functionally while maintaining ownership

-You believe in excellence over easy. You take initiative. You close loops. You care deeply about doing things the right way.



Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Hadley Designs, your work directly impacts families around the world.



You are not just managing operations. You are helping create a seamless experience that allows parents to feel confident, supported, and proud of their choices.



You will enjoy:



-A remote-first environment that gives you flexibility and autonomy

-The ability to manage your schedule with trust and accountability

-Direct access to leadership and meaningful collaboration across teams

-Opportunities to build systems, implement ideas, and drive real impact

-Access to training, tools, and continuous learning

-A decade-strong, family-founded brand with a clear mission and vision

-Free access to products that are changing how children learn



Hadley Designs is a remote-first company built on trust, creativity, and autonomy. We’re a small but mighty team that believes in balancing excellence with flexibility.



Apply Today



Apply today and help us make learning fun, engaging, and screen-free for families everywhere.

title: Chief People Officer
description:

At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.

We are seeking a Chief People Officer to join our team and build the systems that will drive our next phase of growth. If you are passionate about creating scalable people systems, empowering teams, and cultivating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact.



About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.



Our Mission:

We design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. We create beautifully designed, developmentally sound tools that replace noise and distraction with connection, curiosity, and real learning.



Our Vision:

We aim to build the most trusted children’s brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow. Our products will be so widely used and passed down that generations of children will grow up learning from them and choose them again for their own families.



Role Overview

As the Chief People Officer, you will be responsible for leading the development of people systems and strategies that enable Hadley Designs to scale and grow. In this role, you will partner with leadership to create the talent systems required to attract, develop, and retain a high-performing workforce. Your focus will be on building scalable, high-performance systems that align with the company’s growth objectives and help foster a positive organizational culture.

This position offers a unique opportunity to shape how we build and nurture our team, enabling both the company and our people to succeed. You will play an integral role in supporting our mission by ensuring that Hadley Designs has the right talent and organizational structure to achieve long-term success.



Key Responsibilities

- People Systems Leadership: Design and implement systems for attracting, engaging, onboarding, and retaining talent, aligned with the company’s growth objectives. 

- Organizational Design and Capacity Planning: Collaborate with leadership to ensure that the organizational structure and workforce planning meet the evolving needs of the business. 

- Performance and Development Frameworks: Establish performance expectations, evaluation frameworks, and development pathways that drive accountability and growth across the organization. 

- Talent Experience and Retention: Build a consistent and professional experience for talent that reinforces employee engagement, satisfaction, and retention. 

- Workforce Insights and Reporting: Provide insights and data-driven recommendations to leadership to guide decision-making and improve workforce effectiveness. 

- External Partnerships: Partner with external service providers to enhance and support people operations as necessary.



How Success Is Measured

- Successful implementation of people systems that directly support the business’s ability to scale. 

- Strong employee retention rates, with high performance and engagement. 

- Improved leadership confidence in people systems, talent readiness, and organizational alignment. 

- Predictable, scalable people operations that contribute to the company’s growth and success.



Who You Are



You are a strategic, results-driven leader with a passion for creating systems that empower teams and enable sustainable growth. You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and have a track record of building effective people systems in alignment with business goals.



You Have:

- 5+ years of experience in People Operations, HR leadership, or a related field, ideally in a fast-growing environment. 

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field. 

- Proven ability to build scalable systems that attract, develop, and retain talent. 

- Strong experience working with distributed and remote teams. 

- A passion for people development, with the ability to design and implement programs that foster growth, learning, and employee satisfaction. 

- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills at all levels of the organization. 

- A growth mindset and a collaborative approach to solving problems. 

- Experience using data to drive decisions and measure success.



Why You’ll Love Working Here

- Impact: Your work will directly impact how families experience learning through the Hadley Designs brand. 

- Culture: Join a passionate, mission-driven team that values trust, creativity, and collaboration. 

- Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a remote role with flexible working hours. 

 

Benefits: 

- Remote-first work environment  

- Paid time off and holidays  

- Access to learning resources and professional development  

- Free access to Hadley Designs products 

- Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO and CMO  

- Stability from a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

You haven’t had the title yet. But you’ve been doing the work.

You manage more than your role says you should. You think ahead. You follow through without being chased. Your clients or employer rely on you more than they probably admit.

You’re ready for a role that actually matches who you are.



THE ROLE

Market Leaders supports high-performing business owners across Financial Advisory, Real Estate, Coaching, and Education. We’re placing a Personal Assistant to be placed with one of our clients — someone ready to grow into full ownership of the role from day one.

You don’t need five years of corporate EA experience. You need the right character and the drive to own the role.



WHAT YOU BRING

• At least 1 year of VA, admin, or support experience

• Strong English — written and spoken

• Organized, proactive, and high attention to detail

• Philippines-based with SGT availability (GMT+8)

• Comfortable with Google tools, CRM, and social media

• Willingness to learn GHL, Asana, and AI productivity tools



WHAT YOU GET

• A team that backs your growth, not just your output

• Real responsibility from day one

• SGD $700/month (probation) ? SGD $800–900/month post-probation

• Annual increases based on performance



A NOTE ON CULTURE

We have a strict no brilliant jerks policy. Skills matter deeply here — so does how you show up for the people around you.

You’re our kind of person if you deliver excellent work without creating friction, take ownership without needing applause, and genuinely celebrate when a teammate wins.

High Performance. Zero Drama. Peaceful & Profitable — we mean all three.



We know you’re ready. Here’s the shot.



APPLY HERE:

title: Personal Assistant to a High Performing Business Owners
description:
You’ve been doing this work well for a long time.

You anticipate. You solve. You protect the calendar before the conflict happens. You’ve made your executive’s world run smoothly — often without them realizing how much you were carrying.

But somewhere along the way, the environment stopped matching your standards. Too much oversight. Not enough trust. A business you do the work for but don’t really believe in.





This is the role for what comes next.



THE ROLE

We are Market Leaders — a coaching and marketing education brand that supports high-performing business owners across Financial Advisory, Real Estate, Coaching, and Education. As part of our client services team, we’re placing a dedicated PA to support one of our clients directly.

You’ll own the calendar, the inbox, client onboarding, admin operations, social media, GHL — and make everything run before anyone has to ask.



WHAT YOU BRING

• 2+ years of executive assistant or PA experience

• Expert cross-timezone calendar management (Google Calendar)

• Professional written and verbal English

• CRM and client management experience

• Proficiency in GHL, social media, and admin tools

• Philippines-based, available SGT hours (GMT+8)

• Proactive problem-solver who anticipates needs

• High attention to detail, zero tolerance for errors

• Reliable home office setup, stable internet (Philippines-based)

• Singapore Time Zone availability (GMT+8), flexible hours





WHAT YOU GET

• Full trust and autonomy from day one — no micromanagement

• A mission you can genuinely believe in

• Remote 



What You'll Do



Manage executive calendar with zero conflicts

Handle all
 correspondence professionally, responding within 2 hours

Coordinate customer onboarding from inquiry to activation

Solve problems proactively - anticipate challenges and eliminate chaos

Bridge operations across creative teams, clients, and leadership





A NOTE ON CULTURE

We have a strict no brilliant jerks policy. Skills matter deeply here — so does how you show up for the people around you.

You’re our kind of person if you deliver excellent work without creating friction, take ownership without needing applause, and genuinely celebrate when a teammate wins.

High Performance. Zero Drama. Peaceful & Profitable — we mean all three.



If you’re the person who already did the job before anyone asked — this was written for you.



APPLY HERE:

title: AI-Assisted Frontend / Funnel QA Developer (Lovable / React / TypeScript) – Long-Term Opportunity
description:
We’re a fast-growing performance marketing / growth company working with home service businesses in the US.



We run paid traffic (Meta, Google, etc.) to funnels and landing pages that generate real leads for clients. Thousands of dollars in ad spend flow through these systems every week, so reliability matters.



Our landing pages and funnels are primarily built in Lovable, because speed is incredibly important to us. It allows us to launch and iterate fast—but AI-generated projects can sometimes become messy, buggy, or fragile if not properly maintained.



We’re looking for someone smart, detail-oriented, and proactive to become our go-to technical operator for maintaining these systems.



This is NOT a “build massive applications from scratch” role.



This IS a role for someone who understands code well enough to work with AI-generated projects confidently, debug issues quickly, audit systems thoroughly, and keep everything running smoothly.



What you’ll be doing:

- Auditing landing pages, funnels, and lead flows daily

- Testing forms, buttons, redirects, integrations, tracking events, webhooks, etc.

- Finding bugs before they cost us leads or revenue

- Fixing frontend/UI issues quickly

- Reviewing Lovable-generated code and cleaning up problems

- Making updates to React / TypeScript projects

- Verifying that CRM / lead routing / tracking integrations work correctly

- Stress testing user journeys across devices

- Flagging weaknesses, inconsistencies, or potential failures proactively

- Following SOPs and documenting issues clearly



Tech / Skills Required:

You do NOT need to be a senior engineer.



But you MUST understand:

- React / JSX

- TypeScript

- HTML / CSS

- Tailwind CSS

- APIs / webhooks (basic understanding)

- Browser debugging tools

- QA testing / troubleshooting mindset



Huge bonus if you’ve used:

- Lovable

- Vercel

- Supabase

- GoHighLevel

- Zapier / Make / automation tools

- Meta Pixel / conversion tracking



Who we’re looking for:

You are:

- Extremely reliable

- Detail obsessed

- Smart and resourceful

- Comfortable working with AI-assisted development

- Good at debugging

- Fast to respond

- Able to follow instructions clearly

- Comfortable communicating in English (written + spoken)

- Honest and trustworthy

- Looking for a long-term opportunity, not short freelance gigs



If you enjoy spotting problems, fixing messy systems, and keeping high-performance funnels running smoothly, this role is for you.



Application Instructions



To apply, send:

- A short intro about yourself

- Your experience with React / TypeScript / frontend work

- Any experience with Lovable or AI coding tools

- A Loom video (2–5 mins) explaining a bug you’ve fixed before

- Your expected hourly rate

- Your availability / timezone



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the phrase:

“Funnels break. I fix them.”



(Anyone who misses this will be filtered out.)

title: Paid Search Specialist
description:
PeriscoPe is looking for a performance-driven Paid Search (PPC) Marketing Specialist to join our growing team.



This is an opportunity to work with a high-performing digital agency managing campaigns for ambitious ecommerce and lead generation brands across Australia and international markets. You’ll play a key role in developing, managing, and optimising paid media strategies that drive measurable business growth for our clients.



About the Role

As our Paid Search (PPC) Marketing Specialist, you will be responsible for the strategy, execution, optimisation, and reporting of paid search campaigns across multiple platforms including Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and Meta.



You’ll work closely with our wider digital marketing team across SEO, creative, analytics, and strategy to deliver high-performing campaigns focused on growth, efficiency, and ROI.



We’re particularly interested in candidates who are excited by the evolving role of AI, automation, and data in modern performance marketing, and who are keen to help shape how these technologies are implemented across client campaigns and internal workflows.



This is a full-time role based in Burleigh Heads, QLD.



What You’ll Be Doing

Develop and execute paid search strategies designed to drive qualified traffic, revenue, and conversions for clients



Manage and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and other paid media platforms



Conduct in-depth keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience targeting to uncover growth opportunities



Write compelling ad copy and build high-performing campaign structures aligned to client objectives



Continuously optimise bidding strategies, budgets, landing page performance, and audience segmentation



Analyse campaign and conversion data to identify trends, insights, and opportunities for improvement



Leverage AI-powered tools and automation platforms to improve campaign performance, reporting efficiency, and workflow processes



Identify opportunities to integrate automation, scripts, and emerging AI technologies into campaign management and agency operations



Deliver clear and actionable performance reporting to clients and internal stakeholders



Collaborate with our broader strategy, SEO, and creative teams to ensure integrated digital marketing execution



Stay ahead of industry trends, platform updates, automation developments, AI tools, and emerging paid media opportunities



What We’re Looking For

3+ years’ experience managing paid search campaigns in an agency or fast-paced digital marketing environment



Proven experience driving strong performance outcomes across Google Ads and other paid media platforms



Strong understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, analytics, and performance reporting



Hands-on experience with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and related reporting tools



Strong analytical skills with a commercial mindset and attention to detail



Ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-moving environment



Excellent communication and client management skills



A proactive, solutions-focused attitude with a genuine passion for digital marketing and performance media



An interest in AI, automation, and emerging marketing technologies, with a willingness to experiment and innovate



Experience using AI-assisted tools for optimisation, reporting, creative ideation, or workflow efficiency is highly regarded



Understanding of automated bidding strategies, feed-based campaign management, and performance automation best practices



Ecommerce and feed-based advertising experience



Performance Max and advanced automation strategies



CRO and landing page testing experience



Data visualisation and dashboard reporting



Hands-on experience with AI marketing tools, scripts, or automation workflows



What We Offer

At PeriscoPe, we’re building a culture that combines high performance with flexibility, collaboration, and personal growth.



Some of our benefits include:



Competitive salary package based on experience



Ongoing mentorship and career development opportunities



Exposure to exciting national and international brands

title: Part-Time WooCommerce Product Upload & Website Assistant
description:
Long-Term Ongoing Opportunity

Big Branding – Australia



Big Branding is an Australian workwear, uniforms, embroidery and branding company based in Melbourne, Australia.



We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to assist with product uploads and website management for our WordPress / WooCommerce website.



This is a part-time ongoing role with long-term potential for the right person.



We are not looking for a short-term “gig” worker. We are looking for someone who enjoys structured work, follows systems carefully, communicates well, and wants to become part of a growing business over time.



Main Responsibilities

Upload products to WooCommerce

Create and manage product variations (sizes, colours etc.)

Upload and organise product images

Resize/crop images where required

Apply categories, tags, attributes and product data correctly

Format product descriptions and specifications

Assist with website housekeeping and catalogue organisation

Follow naming conventions and upload procedures accurately

Work from supplier catalogues, PDFs and spreadsheets

Save all uploads as drafts for review before publishing

Skills Required

Experience with WordPress and WooCommerce

Strong attention to detail

Good written English communication

Comfortable working with spreadsheets and repetitive tasks

Organised and reliable

Able to follow written and video instructions carefully

Basic image editing skills preferred

Experience with apparel/workwear product uploads is an advantage

About The Role



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys:



organisation,

systems,

consistency,

and structured workflow.



Attention to detail is extremely important to us.



Initially, the role will likely be approximately 10–15 hours per week with flexibility, however additional hours and responsibilities may become available over time.



Interview Process



We prefer a video interview process.



During the interview, we will demonstrate our upload workflow and explain our systems and expectations live via screen share. We believe this is the best way for both parties to understand the role clearly.



To Apply



Please provide:



A short introduction about yourself

Your experience with WooCommerce or Shopify

Examples of similar work you have completed

Your hourly rate

Your internet speed and computer specifications



Thank you and we look forward to speaking with you.



Josh

Big Branding

Australia

title: Paid Social Specialist
description:
PeriscoPe Digital Pty Ltd is seeking a talented and experienced Digital Marketing Manager (Paid Social) to join our dynamic team You will be responsible for developing and executing innovative paid social strategies that drive measurable growth and engagement for our diverse client base.



What you'll be doing

Strategise, implement and optimise paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and emerging platforms

Build and defend strong creative points of view — recommending the right ad formats, creative structures and messaging hierarchies for each objective, and pushing back when briefs don't serve performance

Conduct in-depth audience research and segmentation to identify the most effective targeting approaches

Own attribution — understanding how to set up, interrogate and communicate multi-touch attribution models, interpret discrepancies between platform data and source of truth, and make confident spend decisions from ambiguous data

Actively experiment with AI tools (Meta Advantage+, creative AI, automation scripts, reporting tools) to find efficiency gains and bring new workflows to the team

Continuously monitor campaign performance, analyse data and provide detailed reporting to clients

Collaborate with creative and content teams to produce high-converting ad creative — with a clear perspective on what works and why

Stay up-to-date with the latest paid social trends, platform updates, AI developments and best practices

Minimum 3-4 years in a paid social role with a proven track record of delivering measurable results using significant budgets.

Demonstrated interest in AI tools and automation — you've already started using them to work smarter, not just as a curiosity

In-depth knowledge of major social media advertising platforms and ad management tools

Excellent data analysis and reporting skills with the ability to make data-driven optimisation decisions

Superb communication and client management skills

Degree in Marketing, Digital Media, or a related field — or equivalent experience

title: Social Media Manager and Video Editor

Our mission is simple: empower women with better education, better access, and better solutions in a healthcare space that has been overlooked for far too long.



We are building a modern, trusted digital healthcare brand—and social media will be a major driver of that growth.

-Brand storytelling and positioning

-Content calendar planning

-Short-form video editing

-Graphic/social asset creation

-Social posting and scheduling

-Audience growth initiatives

-Community engagement strategy

You should be someone who sees opportunities before being asked and brings ideas proactively.



Responsibilities

Develop and execute a social media growth strategy across:

-Instagram

-TikTok



-YouTube Shorts

-LinkedIn (bonus)



Take clinician-created educational content and transform it into engaging, patient-friendly content

Edit high-quality short-form videos (Reels / TikTok / Shorts)

-educational carousels

-branded graphics

-thumbnails

-caption copy

-Highly independent

Creative but strategic

-Detail-oriented

-Fast-moving

-Excellent in written English

-Comfortable working asynchronously

-Confident making decisions without hand-holding

-You produce work that requires little to no quality control.

Experience managing healthcare, wellness, digital health, or physician-led brands

Required Skills

Applications without portfolios will not be considered.



This is a part time (20hrs for 2-3 weeks) with quick transition to full time role if we work well together.

title: Junior Automation Specialist
description:
Who is Bare?

Bare is the new way to funeral. We are a holistic end of life care provider, allowing our families to grieve in their own way, at their own pace, knowing their loved one is cared for by a team who truly understand their needs.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalized and affordable. In only five years, we’ve served more than 30,000 families, have become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (with awards in customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and have built a team of more than 100 people committed to changing the way Australians deal with end-of-life. And we’re just getting started.



We’re looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Junior Automation Specialist to join our high-performing remote team. If you're a proactive professional who thrives on ownership, continuous improvement, and meaningful work, we’d love to meet you.



The Junior Automation Specialist works alongside with our current Automation Specialist to build, maintain, and document automations that run Bare Group's finance operations. The role is hands-on technical from day one, with growing autonomy as trust and skill build. Reports to Automation Specialist. Day-to-day collaboration with finance tea
mbers in Slack



Primary responsibilities:

-Build small-to-medium automations end-to-end under Automation Specialist's direction. Make. com scenarios, Google Apps Script, occasional Python — typically 4-12 hours per build.

-Maintain existing automations. Investigate and fix breaks, rate-limit issues, schema changes, expired auth tokens. ~30% of weekly time.

-Write and maintain SOPs. Every live automation needs a written runbook — what it does, how to fix it if broken, who to escalate to.

-Document new builds. Each new automation ships with a build guide so it's not Automation Specialist's knowledge.

-Respond to finance team Slack queries. Automation Specialist still owns the strategic conversations; junior handles routine tactical follow-ups.

-Attend weekly Monday call

-Co-prepare weekly FinOps live teaching sessions with Automation Specialist.



Must-haves:

-1-3 years of professional experience in automation, low-code platforms, or technical support roles.

-Strong working knowledge of at least one no-code/low-code platform: Make. com (preferred), Zapier, n8n, Power Automate.

-Comfortable reading and writing JavaScript or Python at intermediate level — enough to read API documentation and write a script that fetches/transforms/posts data.

-Comfortable with Google Workspace (Sheets formulas, Apps Script, Drive permissions).

-Comfortable reading and consuming REST API documentation (HTTP requests, JSON, OAuth basics).

-Strong written English — Slack, documentation, build guides. Verbal English to a level where they can present in a teaching session.

-Detail-oriented mindset. The work is failure-mode intolerant — a $0.01 invoice rounding error or a wrong AccountCode causes real downstream pain.

-Self-managed and remote-ready. Will be working Manila hours collaborating with Australia-based finance team across timezone overlap.



Strong nice-to-haves:

-Direct experience with Xero API, HubSpot API, or Stripe API.

-Direct experience with Make. com (over Zapier).

-Experience writing technical SOPs or runbooks.

-Experience using Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI tools as a working partner (not just for chat).

-Familiarity with funeral, healthcare, or other process-heavy industries (though not required).

-Background in finance operations, accounting, or accounts payable is a bonus but not essential.



Please send your resume with your application.

title: URGENT HIRING: Virtual Assistant - Administrator, IT and Accounting Xero Certified and have Australian Accounting
description:

/job-opportunities/undergraduate-to-senior-accountant/

Location: Remote (with own internet and office facilities)



Job Type: Contract (may go long term depending on performance)

Health and Life Access is a well-established healthcare consulting Chartered Accounting firm organisation specialising in the management of service entities and organizations throughout Australia and overseas. We are committed to creating a sustainable and socially responsible healthcare system.



Job Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Virtual Assistant to provide administrative, IT, and accounting support to our organisation and clients. The successful candidate will report to the CEO and relevant supervisors, ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of our business.



Key Responsibilities:

Provide administrative, IT, and accounting support to the CEO and other consultants/managers.

Maintain accurate records, perform bookkeeping, and handle client billing.

Assist with financial reporting, budgeting, and petty cash management.

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or
 



[Closing Message]

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

-Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders

-Understanding of direct response principles and how editing impacts conversion

-Include word "banana" in your application to prove your legit



Accountabilities:



-Edit 10-20 video ads per week from provided scripts, raw footage, and assets

-Create multiple variations of winning ads (different hooks, text overlays, pacing)

-Add compelling captions, text overlays, sound effects, and visual effects that enhance performance

Source and integrate b-roll, stock footage, and motion graphics as needed

-Maintain brand consistency across all video content while optimizing for performance

When hiring, we'll work with you to define the KPIs you'll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you're doing a good job after you start.



Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project (edit 2-3 ads from provided footage), and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.



For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

title: AI-Assisted Junior Developer
description:
AI-Assisted Junior Developer

Claude Code • GitHub • Supabase • Vercel • Railway • APIs



We are looking for a technical, fast-moving AI-Assisted Junior Developer to help build custom apps, internal tools, dashboards, automations, and business systems.



The main focus of this role is using Claude Code and AI-assisted development to move quickly from instructions, Loom videos, and specs into working software.



You do not need to be a senior developer, but you do need a real technical foundation. You should be comfortable working in codebases, using GitHub, connecting APIs, troubleshooting errors, and testing your own work.



This is not a Zapier-only automation role. We may use automation tools occasionally, but the core of this role is building and maintaining real software systems.



WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON



You’ll help build practical software systems for small businesses, including:



- Custom internal apps

- Client portals

- Dashboards

- AI-powered business tools

- CRM-style systems

- API integrations

- Workflow automations

- Payment and billing workflows

- Reporting tools

- Internal operations systems



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



- Use Claude Code and AI coding tools to build features quickly

- Work inside existing codebases using GitHub

- Create branches, commits, and pull requests

- Build custom apps, portals, dashboards, and internal tools

- Connect systems using APIs, webhooks, and databases

- Work with Supabase for databases, auth, storage, and app backends

- Set up and troubleshoot deployments on Vercel and Railway

- Integrate payment and billing workflows using Stripe

- Debug errors and solve technical problems independently

- Test features carefully before marking them complete

- Document what you build so it can be maintained or handed off later

- Communicate clearly about progress, blockers, and next steps



REQUIRED SKILLS



You should have experience or strong working knowledge of:



- JavaScript or TypeScript

- React, Next.js, or similar frontend frameworks

- Basic backend development concepts

- REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON

- Databases such as Supabase, PostgreSQL, Firebase, or similar

- Git and GitHub

- Debugging code and reading error messages

- Using AI tools to assist with coding and problem-solving

- Strong written English communication

- Ability to follow detailed instructions without needing constant supervision



You do not need to be an expert in every tool, but you should be technical enough to understand what the tools are doing, test the output, and fix things when they break.



MAIN TOOLS YOU’LL USE



- Claude Code

- Slack

- GitHub

- Vercel

- Railway

- Supabase

- Stripe

- APIs

- Webhooks

- Custom apps and internal business systems



YOU ARE A GREAT FIT IF YOU ARE



- Fast at using Claude Code to build and iterate

- Comfortable working in codebases, not just no-code tools

- Able to take a Loom video or written spec and turn it into a working feature

- Good at debugging independently

- Careful enough to test your work before submitting it

- Honest when something is outside your current skillset

- Excited by practical business systems, not just toy projects

- Comfortable moving fast while still being organized

- Reliable, responsive, and consistent



NOT A FIT IF



- Your experience is mostly limited to Zapier, Make, or no-code automation tools

- You are not comfortable reading, editing, or debugging code

- You have never used GitHub or version control

- You need constant step-by-step guidance

- You wait for instructions instead of investigating problems

- You avoid testing your own work

- You prefer slow planning over shipping working products



BONUS EXPERIENCE



Helpful, but not required:



- Claude Code experience

- Cursor, Codex, or other AI coding tool experience

- Supabase auth, RLS, storage, or database experience

- Vercel or Railway deployment experience

- Stripe integration experience

- CRM, client portal, dashboard, or internal tool experience

- Experience building apps for small businesses



HOURS & PAY



- Part-time to start: approximately 20 hours/week

- Opportunity to move to full-time within 4–6 weeks based on performance

- Starting pay: $400/month

- Pay can increase based on speed, reliability, technical ability, and quality of work



This is a long-term role for someone who wants to grow into a more advanced technical builder position.



ABOUT DRAGONFLY AI



Dragonfly AI builds practical AI-powered systems for small businesses.



We help business owners clean up messy workflows, connect scattered tools, automate repetitive tasks, and turn daily operations into clear, reliable systems.



We build things like custom apps, dashboards, CRMs, client portals, automations, AI tools, and internal business systems.



Our goal is not AI hype. Our goal is to build useful systems that save time, reduce manual work, and actually get used.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short intro about yourself

2. A description of one technical project you have built

3. Links to your GitHub, portfolio, live apps, or code samples, if available

4. Your experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, APIs, databases, and GitHub

5. How you use Claude Code or other AI coding tools in your workflow

6. The word “Operator” in your response to confirm attention to detail

7. Your favorite AI coding tool and why



Please do not only describe Zapier, Make, or automation workflows.



I want to see technical work: code, apps, APIs, databases, custom systems, or deployed projects.



APPLICATION TEST



Please answer this as part of your application:



If I gave you a broken Next.js app connected to Supabase, and users were unable to log in, what steps would you take to diagnose the issue?



Your answer does not need to be perfect. I want to understand how you think, debug, and troubleshoot technical problems.

title: Sign Industry Estimator
description:
**MUST BE AVAILABLE MONDAY THROUGH FRIDAY 8am-4pm MST



Position Overview



We are a custom sign manufacturing and installation company seeking an experienced Estimator to join our team remotely. In this role, you will read and interpret architectural and shop drawings, develop accurate cost estimates, and build winning bids for interior and exterior sign projects ranging from single-tenant signage to multi-location rollouts. You will work closely with sales, project managers, fabrication, and installation crews to ensure every estimate reflects true scope, true cost, and a margin we can stand behind.



This is a fully remote position with regular collaboration via Microsoft Teams. The right candidate is detail-obsessed, deadline-driven, and comfortable owning the numbers from takeoff through bid handoff.



Key Responsibilities



• Read and interpret drawings: Review architectural plans, elevations, site plans, shop drawings, electrical drawings, and landlord/municipal sign criteria packages to define accurate scope.

• Perform quantity takeoffs: Extract material types, square footage, linear footage, hardware counts, and electrical specs from drawings and RFP documents.

• Build complete estimates: Price materials, fabrication labor, finishing, freight, permitting, engineering, installation labor, equipment (lifts, cranes, traffic control), and applicable markups.

• Specify installation scope: Determine mounting methods, wall conditions, electrical requirements, lift or crane needs, permitting obligations, and crew sizing for both interior and exterior installs.

• Source and quote vendors: Solicit and evaluate quotes from material suppliers, sub-fabricators, electrical sign manufacturers, permit runners, and installation subcontractors.

• Maintain pricing data: Work with Purchasing to ensure material, labor, and burden rates are current 

• Produce bid documents: Deliver clean, client-ready proposals with clear scope, inclusions, exclusions, assumptions, lead times, and payment terms.

• Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with sales on pursuit strategy, with production on buildability, and with project managers on smooth job handoff after award.

• Track and analyze: Maintain a bid log, hit-rate tracking, and post-job cost reviews to continuously sharpen estimating accuracy.



Required Qualifications



• Sign industry experience: 3+ years estimating in custom signage (channel letters, monuments, pylons, wayfinding, ADA, dimensional, vinyl/graphics, and electrical signage).

• Drawing literacy: Demonstrated ability to read architectural drawings, shop drawings, electrical schematics, and sign criteria packages without hand-holding.

• Pricing fluency: Strong working knowledge of sign materials (aluminum, acrylic, LEDs, power supplies, vinyl, hardware), fabrication processes, finishes, and labor burden.

• Installation knowledge: Practical understanding of interior and exterior install methods, wall types, mounting hardware, electrical hookup, lifts, cranes, and permitting workflows.

• Excel proficiency: Comfortable with formulas, lookups (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH), pivot tables, and conditional logic; able to build and maintain estimating workbooks.

• ERP software: Hands-on experience with an ERP or job costing system (e.g., CYRIOUS Control, Shopify Sign, NetSuite, Sage, or similar). Must be able to enter and pull data confidently.

• Microsoft Teams: Comfortable working remotely through Teams for meetings, chat, file collaboration, and channel-based project communication.

• Communication: Clear written communication for proposals, scope clarifications, and vendor follow-ups; comfortable on video calls with internal teams and clients.

• Work environment: Reliable remote workspace, dedicated workstation with dual monitors recommended, and stable high-speed internet.



Preferred Qualifications



• Experience in estimating national rollouts or multi-site programs.

• Familiarity with UL listing requirements for electric signs.

• Working knowledge of local permitting processes and landlord criteria packages.

• Bluebeam, AutoCAD, or other PDF/CAD markup experience.

• Background in fabrication, project management, or field installation before moving into estimating.



What Success Looks Like in This Role



• Estimates are accurate, complete, and submitted on or before deadline.

• Bid hit rate improves quarter-over-quarter without margin erosion.

• Post-job cost variance stays within target on awarded work.

• Sales, production, and installation teams trust the numbers and the scope handoff.



Submit your resume along with a brief note describing: (1) the largest or most complex sign project you have estimated, (2) the ERP system you have used most, and (3) your approach to estimating an exterior illuminated channel letter set on an unfamiliar building. Strong candidates will be invited to a working session that includes a sample takeoff.

title: Remote Project Manager | Custom Sign Manufacturing
description:
About the Company



We are a growing custom sign manufacturing company specializing in high-quality, made-to-order signage for businesses, events, retail, and architectural projects. From concept and design through fabrication, installation, and delivery, we deliver creative, durable solutions that help our clients stand out. We pride ourselves on craftsmanship, clear communication, and on-time project delivery.



**MUST BE AVAILABLE MONDAY THROUGH FRIDAY 8am-4pm MST



Job Summary



We are looking for a highly organized, client-focused Remote Project Manager to oversee the full lifecycle of custom sign projects. In this role, you will act as the central coordinator between clients, designers, production teams, vendors, and installers. You will ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standards, all while working remotely with strong digital tools and processes.

This is a key role for scaling our operations without expanding physical office space. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, custom manufacturing environment and excels at managing multiple projects simultaneously.



Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients from initial quote through final installation and follow-up.

• Gather project requirements, manage design reviews, approvals, and revisions using digital proofing tools.

• Create and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, and resource allocation using project management software.

• Coordinate with the in-house production team, shop leads, and subcontractors to schedule fabrication, assembly, shipping, and installation.

• Track material orders, lead times, and inventory needs; proactively manage supply chain risks.

• Handle change orders, scope adjustments, and client communications professionally.

• Monitor project budgets, profitability, and margins; flag and resolve variances quickly.

• Conduct regular virtual check-ins with clients and internal teams; provide clear status updates and risk reports.

• Ensure all projects meet quality standards and compliance requirements (permitting, safety, etc.).

• Maintain accurate project documentation, photos, and records in our shared systems.

• Continuously improve workflows and templates for common sign types to increase efficiency.



Requirements & Qualifications



• 3+ years of Project Management experience in manufacturing, fabrication, construction, signage, or a similar custom/project-based industry (strongly preferred).

• Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a remote or hybrid environment.

• Know how to create and manage a Gantt Chart

• Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Waterfall + Agile/hybrid approaches).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, you’re comfortable being the “face” of the company to clients.

• High proficiency with Microsoft project management tools and cloud file-sharing platforms.

• Experience with e-signature tools, digital proofing, and basic CRM/ERP systems is a plus.

• The ability to read and interpret technical drawings, CAD files, or shop drawings is highly desirable.

• Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.

• Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional remote workspace.



Preferred Skills & Experience



• Background in signage, graphics, printing, metal fabrication, or architectural products.

• PMP, CAPM, or similar certification.

• Familiarity with common sign materials (acrylic, aluminum, vinyl, LED lighting, etc.) and typical lead times.

• Experience managing installation logistics and permitting processes.

I am looking for a video that helps me imagine a scenario clearly and emotionally. It should show a sequence of events, with music, images, or clips that tell a story. The focus is on how it feels, not just visuals. You need to use your creativity to make everything come together, including backgrounds, scenes, and the flow of the story.



What You Will Do



Make a short video or montage that tells a story visually.

Use photos, video clips, or images you create or find. You may need to design backgrounds or add visual effects.

Arrange the sequence so the story feels real and emotional.

Add music and simple effects to make the video polished and professional.

The first version doesn’t have to be perfect, but it should be very close to perfect (around 80%). I can then give feedback for final tweaks.



Requirements

Proven experience creating similar videos. Must show samples of previous work.

Creative and able to tell a story with images and video.

Knowledge of apps like Mind Movies, Canva, or similar tools.

Welcome!



If you are somebody looking for a full-time, long term position at a fast growing e-commerce company, you are in the right place.

title: Support Engineer Level 1 I Fulltime I Remote
description:
Support Engineer (L1) — Full-Time | Remote

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a reliable and client-focused Support Engineer to join our remote MSP support team. This is an L1-level role and the first point of contact for our clients. You'll handle inbound requests, resolve common issues, and escalate where needed — all while delivering a professional, responsive experience. You'll work in a structured, ticket-driven environment with clear processes and strong team support behind you.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



First-Line Client Support (60%)





Act as the first point of contact for client support requests via phone,
, and ticketing system

Triage, log, and prioritise incoming tickets in HaloPSA

Resolve L1 issues within your scope — password resets, account access, basic connectivity, M365 queries, and common endpoint issues

Escalate tickets clearly and promptly to L2 when required

Maintain professional, clear communication with clients throughout





Microsoft 365 & Endpoint Support (20%)





Assist with basic M365 administration — user creation, licence assignment, mailbox management

Support basic Intune and Defender tasks within defined scope

Follow documented runbooks and SOPs for common tasks





Ticket Management & Documentation (10%)





Keep tickets updated with accurate time entries and clear notes

Create and update knowledge base articles where appropriate

Follow escalation and communication protocols consistently





Monitoring & Alert Response (10%)





Action basic monitoring alerts per documented procedures

Escalate anomalies to L2 or senior staff promptly



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



1–2 years in a helpdesk or technical support role, preferably in an MSP

Working knowledge of:



Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, basic admin)

Windows 10/11 desktop support

Basic networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, connectivity troubleshooting)





Strong client communication skills — professional, clear, and calm under pressure

Excellent written English and near-native spoken English

Organised, reliable, and process-driven

Comfortable following SOPs and escalating when outside scope



HIGHLY VALUED



Experience with ticketing systems (HaloPSA or similar)

Exposure to Intune, Defender, or Entra ID

Manufacturing or wholesale industry client exposure

Any Microsoft certifications (e.g. MS-900, MD-102) are a bonus



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Salary: ?60,000 – ?70,000/month depending on experience, paid twice monthly

Hours: 37.5 hours per week. Shifts are scheduled between 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM Sydney (AEDT/AEST) time

Public Holidays: Australian public holidays observed and paid from day one



The following benefits apply after successful completion of the 3-month probationary period:



Annual Leave: 4 weeks fully paid leave per calendar year



3 weeks during the Christmas/New Year shutdown (aligned to Australian holidays)

5 days at your discretion with prior approval





HMO Allowance: Provided annually — you arrange your own HMO policy



REQUIREMENTS



Stable, high-speed internet with low latency

Quiet, professional workspace for client calls

Available during Australian business hours

Able to pass a practical technical assessment during the hiring process



TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE:



A brief intro message or cover letter

A short video (60–90 seconds) introducing yourself, telling us about your customer service or IT support experience, and why you'd be a good fit for this role. Phone camera is OK, just make sure we can clearly hear you

Your available working hours

Confirmation you're comfortable completing a timed technical assessment

title: Construction Accountant
description:
******TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME AND A VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING!******



Construction Accountant



Job Type: Full Time

Work Hours: 10:00 AM - 06:30 PM Pacific Time.

Salary: $1200 per month



* Job Overview: 

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Construction Accountant to support our construction projects by managing documentation, ensuring subcontractor compliance, and maintaining accurate financial records. In this role, you will assist with monthly invoicing, track contract values and change orders, collect and verify compliance documents, and keep project management systems updated. You will work closely with project managers, field teams, subcontractors, and clients to ensure smooth project operations, timely communication, and accurate documentation throughout each phase of the project.



* Key Responsibilities:

Assist with monthly subcontractor invoicing, including document review and accuracy checks

Collect, verify, and track lien releases, certificates of insurance (COI), W-9s, and other compliance documents

Monitor contract values, change orders, and budget adjustments, and update internal logs accordingly

Maintain organized project documentation, digital filing systems, and project folders

Update project management platforms (Procore) and accounting systems (Sage 100 Contractor) with current project data

Coordinate document flow between office teams, field staff, subcontractors, and clients

Ensure subcontractor compliance with contractual requirements prior to payment processing

Generate project reports, cost logs, and status updates as requested by the Project Manager

Support project kickoff activities, closeout documentation, and ongoing communication across all stakeholders

Assist with scheduling, meeting coordination, and various administrative tasks related to project operations



* Qualifications:

Previous experience in construction administration, project coordination, or a similar role

Strong understanding of construction documentation, billing processes, and compliance requirements

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook)

Experience using Sage 100 Contractor and Procore project management software (required or highly preferred)

Exceptional organizational skills and strong attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple deadlines and follow up proactively

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Ability to work effectively with project managers, field teams, subcontractors, and clients

Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities





Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

description:
**About Genesis SEO**

We help construction and home services companies win local markets with practical SEO, clean websites, and content that builds real authority. We move fast, keep communication professional, and measure outcomes.



## The Role



You will be the bridge between our technical systems and our clients' success. You will own the client onboarding process after their website is built, ensuring they are fully trained and integrated into our GoHighLevel (GHL) ecosystem. Your goal is to build relationships with clients while designing and maintaining the automation engines that drive their business—from review requests and database reactivation to "voi
 bombs" and unified communication pipelines.



The whole team is expected to work: Working Hours: 4PM PST to 11:30 PM PST. With 30 min of lunch in between and be availle 



## What You’ll Do



### Client Onboarding & Account Management



Lead the Handoff: Take ownership of the client relationship immediately after the website build is complete.



Training & Support: Conduct front-end and back-end training sessions, teaching clients and their teams how to use their new systems (CRM, pipelines, and reporting).



Ongoing Communication: Host weekly or monthly performance meetings to review work completed, discuss metrics, and coordinate next steps.



Team Liaison: Act as the central point of contact, communicating client needs clearly to the rest of our professional team to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.



### GHL Automation & System Architecture



Unified Communications: Set up and maintain a centralized inbox that merges Yelp, website widgets, SMS, and
 into one platform.



Automated Outreach: Build and manage workflows for automated review requests, referral generation, and repeat appointment reminders.



Database Reactivation: Execute "voi
 bombs" and text/email blasts to send targeted mass communications to leads and customer lists.



Phone Systems: Configure VoIP systems for clients, ensuring call tracking, recording, and metrics are functioning correctly.



### Marketing Campaigns & Reporting



Lifecycle Marketing: Create and manage
 campaigns tailored to specific stages of the sales funnel, including seasonal blasts and monthly newsletters.



Chat Widgets: Install and configure website chat widgets for real-time lead capture.



Reporting: Design customized dashboards inside GHL that provide clients with clear visibility into their ROI and KPIs.



Social & Content: Assist with social media planning for repeat content and ensure consistent messaging across all channels.



### What Success Looks Like (Accountability)



Smooth Onboarding: Clients feel confident and supported during the transition from "build" to "live."



System Uptime: Automations trigger correctly, and communication channels (VoIP, Chat, SMS) remain active without error.



Client Retention: Clients see the value of the software through your regular reporting meetings and proactive support.



Documentation: All workflows, client interaction notes, and task statuses are documented clearly in ClickUp.



When you apply, write the title of your job post as “GHL Automation Specialist 49 from” and then add your name to be considered.



Response Time: Client inquiries regarding their accounts or software are addressed promptly and professionally.



### Your Authority



Make decisions on the best automation logic for specific client needs.



Propose new GHL features or workflows that could benefit our client base.



Manage the client meeting schedule and set the agenda for performance reviews.



**Must-Haves (Skills and Tools)**



- **Expert-Level GoHighLevel (GHL):** Deep understanding of snapshots, workflows, pipelines, triggers, and smart lists.

- **VoIP & Telephony Experience:** Ability to set up Twilio/LeadConnector phone numbers, call forwarding, and voi
 drops.

- **Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written English; comfortable leading Zoom calls with business owners and training non-technical staff.

- *
 Marketing:** Experience writing and designing newsletters and drip campaigns that convert.

- **Project Management:** Organized in ClickUp or similar PM tools; you document your process and decisions.

- **Professional Presence:** Positive, proactive, and solution-focused; camera on during 1:1 and team calls.



**Nice-to-Haves**



- Experience with N8N or Zapier for integrations outside of GHL.

- Basic understanding of SEO and how it feeds into the CRM pipelines.

- Experience with social media scheduling tools.

- HTML/CSS knowledge for
 template customization.



### Working Hours (Long-Term Only)



- Monday–Friday, **8 hours/day**

- Core availability: **7:00 AM – 3:00 PM (your local time)**

- Respond within **2 hours** during working hours

- Acknowledge task comments the same day

- If you’ll be delayed, proactively explain it

title: SEO Content Strategist & Writer (Home Services Only, Remote)
description:
**About Genesis SEO**



We help home services and construction companies win local markets with practical SEO, clean Webflow websites, and content that drives real leads. We only work with home services. No lawyers, no random industries.



### The Role



This is a strategist + senior writer role. You will build a **Keyword Domination Plan** for each client, then execute it through content and on-page SEO. The goal is to help clients start ranking faster for their core services, then expand into supporting topics that build authority.



### What You’ll Do



**1) Strategy (Domination Plans)**



- Do keyword research using **SEMrush, Keyword Planner, and Surfer SEO**

- Build a clear Domination Plan (what pages/topics ship first, second, third)

- Turn it into weekly deliverables and keep it visible in **ClickUp**



**2) Writing (E-E-A-T + conversion-focused)**



- Write/optimize service pages, supporting pages, city pages, landing pages, blogs, and occasional case studies

- Write content that’s accurate, useful, and built to convert real customers

- Structure content to perform in Google and be readable/usable for AI platforms



**3) On-page SEO (practical)**



- Titles, metas, H1/H2 structure, intent match, and conversion updates

- Internal linking plans + help prevent/fix cannibalization

- Communicate basic schema needs to dev (AI generates schema, you just specify what’s needed)



**4) Collaboration + Publishing**



- Coordinate with our Webflow developer (copy aligned to wireframes/UX)

- QA pages before publish (formatting, links, on-page checklist)

- Document work clearly in ClickUp

- Support quarterly/semi-annual reporting inputs tied to what shipped



### Our Tool Stack (fixed)



- **Webflow** (all sites)

- **ClickUp** (only PM tool)

- **SEMrush, Google Keyword Planner, Surfer SEO**

- **ChatGPT** (to speed up work, not replace thinking)



No Screaming Frog, regex/server logs, backlinking, or outreach in this role.



---



### Detail Check (Required)



To be considered, start your application message with:



**“SEO Content Writer 49 from, [Your Name]”**



---



### Must-Haves



- Proven experience building keyword-based content plans and executing them

- Strong SEO writing for service pages + long-form content (clear, helpful, conversion-minded)

- Solid on-page fundamentals (titles, metas, headings, internal links, avoiding cannibalization)

- Comfortable collaborating with a developer in Webflow workflows

- Organized and consistent with documentation in ClickUp

- Professional communication; camera on during 1:1 and team calls



### Nice-to-Haves (Not Required)



- Topical maps / content architecture experience for local service businesses

- Strong brand voice and copywriting range across multiple clients

- Interest in helping build future content automation systems (planned within 6 months)



### Pay, Incentives, and Growth



- **Base pay (Phase 1, first 3 months): $900**

- **Bonuses + incentive program:** tied to client milestones based on quarterly/semi-annual reporting (depends on client plan)

- **Pay scaling:** increases after Phase 1 based on performance

- **Year-end bonuses:** available for top performers

- **Leadership track:** lead roles available within **6–12 months** for strong performers



### Working Hours (Long-Term Only)



- Monday–Friday, **8 hours/day**

- Core availability: **7:00 AM – 3:00 PM (your local time)**

- Respond within **2 hours** during working hours

- Acknowledge task comments the same day

- If you’ll be delayed, proactively explain it

• Minimum 5 years of experience in construction estimating, pricing, operations, or pre-construction
