• Strong understanding of roofing, siding, windows, gutters, flashing, waterproofing, labor production, and material systems

• Ability to build and maintain pricing structures and cost databases

• Strong understanding of gross margins, profitability, labor burden, and operational costing

• Experience creating SOPs, operational systems, templates, and scalable processes

• Strong communication and leadership skills

• Fast response time and strong sense of urgency

• Highly organized and detail oriented

• Ability to support sales while protecting company profitability



ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES



This position owns:

• Company pricing structures

• Residential and commercial price lists

• Labor production assumptions

• Estimate quality control

• Contract structure consistency

• Scope verification

• Sales estimating support

• Margin protection

• Cost tracking coordination

• SOP creation and implementation

• Estimating templates and operational systems

• Coordination between sales and production teams

• Vendor pricing updates and material tracking



The Estimating & Pricing Manager acts as the operational bridge between Sales and Production.

• A paperwork coordinator

• A low-level admin role

• A commission-only sales position



This is an ownership role.



The right person will help build the operational foundation of the company and directly impact growth, profitability, and scalability.



COMPENSATION



Compensation includes:

• Base salary

• Quarterly performance bonuses

• Margin performance incentives

• Closed project incentives



A highly motivated individual who creates systems, improves profitability, supports sales effectively, protects production, and takes true ownership of the estimating and pricing department will have significant long-term growth and income opportunity within the company.

The technician will support primarily Microsoft-based environments and must be comfortable learning new systems and troubleshooting a wide variety of issues. One ticket may involve installing a printer driver. The next may require diagnosing a VoIP phone problem. Success in this role depends on curiosity, adaptability, and clear communication as much as technical ability.

- Provide remote technical support to U.S.-based end users via ticketing system and inbound phone calls

- Communicate clearly and professionally with users, setting expectations and explaining technical issues in plain language

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues on Windows workstations and peripherals

- Support Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and user account-related issues

- Install and configure printer drivers, software applications, and system updates

- Assist with troubleshooting VoIP phone systems, including device configuration, connectivity, and basic call quality issues

- Use remote access and RMM tools to diagnose and remediate endpoint issues

- Document troubleshooting steps, findings, and resolutions accurately in the ticketing system

- Escalate complex issues with clear context and supporting details

- Collaborate with Lead Technician and Dispatch to maintain efficient ticket flow



- Required Skills & Traits -



- Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate confidently over the phone

- Strong customer-facing communication skills; ability to work directly with a U.S.-based user population

- Willingness to learn and take ownership of unfamiliar technical issues

- Experience in a technical support or service desk role, or equivalent hands-on technical experience

- Working knowledge of Windows operating systems

- Ability to remain calm, clear, and professional (and upbeat) during live support interactions



- Preferred Qualifications -



- Familiarity with Microsoft 365 environments

- Basic understanding of networking concepts (connectivity, DNS awareness, VoIP fundamentals)

- Prior experience providing phone-based technical support to U.S. customers

- Familiarity with VoIP phone systems and endpoint hardware

- Experience supporting printers and peripheral devices

title: Bookkeeper- QuickBooks Online, Profit First & Excel Reporting
description:
About this role

Collaborative RED (CRED) is a small owner's project management and real estate development firm based near Boston, MA USA. We're looking for an experienced, detail-driven bookkeeper to take full ownership of our ongoing financial operations across three related entities all managed within a single QuickBooks Online file using "locations".



Our previous bookkeeper built the foundation: the chart of accounts is set up, transaction rules are in place, and our custom Excel workbook for Profit First allocations and budget-vs.-actual tracking is complete. You're stepping into a clean, organized system and maintaining it,not rebuilding from scratch.



This is a long-term recurring engagement but limited hours per month. We value precision and reliability above everything else.



Core responsibilities



Monthly close & reconciliation

- Reconcile all four bank accounts and one credit card monthly across all three entities

- Review, categorize, and clean all transactions to ensure 100?curacy and correct entity allocation

- Close the books each month with complete, audit-ready records

- Identify and resolve discrepancies, duplicates, uncategorized entries, and misallocations

- Maintain and refine QuickBooks rules to improve automation accuracy over time



Profit First & budget-vs.-actual reporting

- Export QuickBooks data into our existing Excel reporting workbook on a regular cadence

- Populate Profit First allocation calculations (Revenue, Profit, Owner's Comp, Tax, Operating Expenses) in our pre-built template

- Update budget-vs.-actual tracking so the principal has clear visibility into financial performance

- Flag variances, anomalies, or trends that need attention



Data integrity & QuickBooks maintenance

- Keep the chart of accounts clean, logically organized, and consistently applied across all entities

- Maintain vendor records, transaction rules, and categorization logic

- Ensure inter-company transactions are properly recorded and reconciled

- Proactively flag any data quality issues or process improvement opportunities



----How we work together — please read this section carefully-----



We understand that great bookkeepers prefer deep, focused work over constant meetings, and we respect that. However, communication and visibility are non-negotiable parts of this role, especially in the first several months. If this doesn't sound like the right fit for you, this role is probably not right for you, and that is completely okay. We'd rather know now.



Here is exactly how this role works:



- Weekly async Loom recording (first 3–6 months): Each week you will send a short ~10-minute screen recording walking through your progress, open items, and any questions. You record it on your schedule, no live meeting required. This requirement phases out once we have established a strong working rhythm, typically after 3–6 months.

- Monthly 30-minute video call: One live synchronous check-in per month with the principal to review open items, answer questions, and align on priorities.

- Ad-hoc communication via Microsoft Teams and Outlook
 for quick questions or clarifications.



The monthly call must fall within 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM Eastern Time (Boston, USA). For Philippines-based candidates, this translates to approximately 8:00 PM – 8:00 AM Philippine Standard Time. We are flexible within that window and will work with your schedule to find a time that respects your life. This availability requirement is firm — please do not apply if this window does not work for you.



---



Required qualifications



- Demonstrated expertise in QuickBooks Online, including multi-location setup, bank reconciliation, rules management, and chart of accounts configuration

- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, ability to work within structured workbooks with formulas, linked tabs, and formatted reporting templates

- Experience managing books for multiple related entities simultaneously

- Familiarity with the Profit First cash management methodology, or a willingness to learn quickly with guidance

- High attention to detail with a commitment to 100?curacy and clean, audit-ready records

- Professional, proactive communication,  you flag issues and ask clarifying questions rather than making assumptions

- Comfort recording and sending Loom or similar screen-share videos as a regular part of your workflow

- Availability for one 30-minute monthly call between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM Eastern Time, non-negotiable



---



Preferred qualifications



- Prior experience with Profit First reporting, including allocation percentages and target-vs.-actual tracking

- Experience working with real estate development, construction, or professional services firms

- Experience working with owner's project management companies

- Demonstrated track record with long-term remote client relationships



---



Scope at a glance



- Entities in scope: 3 (1 primary + 2 sister companies)

- Monthly transaction volume: ~100 transactions

- Bank accounts to reconcile: 4

- Credit cards to reconcile: 1

- Accounting software: QuickBooks Online

- Reporting tool: Microsoft Excel (existing template — already built)

- Async check-ins: Weekly Loom (~10 min) for first 3–6 months

- Sync meetings: Monthly · 30 min

- Call availability required: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM Eastern Time (8:00 PM – 8:00 AM PHT)



---



How to apply, follow these instructions exactly



We receive many applications. The only applications we will review are those that follow all three steps below. This is intentional, it is a preview of how this role works.



1. Record a Document Walkthrough Video (3–5 minutes) We do not want a general introduction video. Instead, record yourself walking through the financial document linked below as if you were presenting it to a manager or client:



???? 



Your video should cover:



   º What the document shows and how it is structured

    º Key figures or line items worth highlighting

    º How you would identify and flag any issues, variances, or discrepancies



This tells us far more about how you work than an introduction ever could. Use Loom (preferred) or any equivalent screen recording tool. Applications without this specific document walkthrough video will not be reviewed.



2. Send your Loom link along with a short written summary of your relevant experience and your proposed monthly retainer.

3. Begin your message with the phrase "I read the full post" so we know you did.



Applications without a Loom video will not be reviewed. We are not trying to be difficult, we are trying to find someone who communicates this way naturally, because that is how this role works from day one.

title: Client Care Specialist (Neutral Accent, Dog Lovers, 9–5 ET) — Long-Term Role
description:
Client Care Specialist (Neutral Accent, Dog Lovers, 9–5 ET) — Long-Term Role



Are you a dog lover? If yes, this might be the job for you. You'll be working with US customers whose dogs are taking amazing herbal supplements and helping those customers feel cared for, every single message and every single call.



This is a long-term role. If you're great, we want you with us for years, not months. We're hiring carefully because we want to grow with the right person.



We're a small pet supplement company. Our customers are devoted dog parents, their dogs are all ages, some healthy and some dealing with health issues and they reach out to us by
, text, and phone for help. We have a strong in-house knowledge base, and we'll train you thoroughly on our products, our customers, and our process before you ever speak with a customer.



This is not a high-volume call center. We're a small, personable business where each customer gets dedicated, white-glove client care. You'll have time to actually listen, to remember a customer's dog's name from her last call, and to treat every
 and every phone call like it matters.



What you'll do

Read and reply to customer service
s

Reply to customer text messages

Help customers place orders, track shipments, and resolve order issues

Set up appointments with our head herbalist for customers who want a deeper conversation about their dog

Answer phone calls when they come in. Some days are busier than others, but whenever the phone rings, that's your first priority.



Who you are

Your English is clear with a neutral accent. Have past US customers ever been surprised to find out you weren't based in the US? If yes, please tell us about it in your application. Most of our customers are older American women (ages 40-65). They need to understand you the first time, every time.



Warm, calm, and patient on the phone. You sound like someone who could comfort a worried grandma.

A genuine dog lover. You'll be talking about dogs all day, every day — their names, their ages, their conditions, their quirks.

Kind during hard conversations. Sometimes a customer will tell you their dog was just diagnosed with something serious, or has just passed away. We don't expect you to have all the medical answers — we just want you to be kind, to listen, and to let them know you understand.

Reliable. You show up on time, you follow up, you don't drop the ball.

Comfortable with technology. You don't need to already know our specific tools — we'll train you on those. But if you do already know any customer service, e-commerce, or admin tools, please list them in your application. And if you have any other work skill that could help a small company like ours (bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, etc.), please tell us about that too.



Requirements

2+ years of customer service experience, ideally answering US customers

Reliable home internet with at least 25 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, and ping under 50ms, on a wired Ethernet connection (not WiFi alone). Please include a current speedtest.net screenshot showing your download speed, upload speed, and ping — and tell us in your
 what internet plan you have and whether you're on Ethernet or WiFi.



A quiet home office. No background noise on calls — no roosters, no traffic, no kids, no neighbors. Backup power or a hotspot in case of outages is a strong plus.

Quality USB headset with a noise-cancelling microphone

Modern computer (Windows or Mac, less than 5 years old)

Available 9:00am–5:00pm US Eastern Time, Monday–Friday. That's 9:00pm–5:00am Philippines time. Please only apply if you can genuinely commit to that overnight schedule, long-term.

ID Proof verified on your OnlineJobs.ph profile — we only review applications from ID-verified accounts.



Nice to have

You've worked for a small US-based e-commerce brand answering US customers, and those customers never realized you weren't based in the US. This is the experience we care about most.

Familiarity with any customer service or e-commerce tools (Richpanel, helpdesks, e-comm platforms,
 tools) — list anything you've used

Other work skills that could help a small company — bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, scheduling, anything you do well



We'll watch your video and read your application. If we like you, we'll reach out. At that point we'll ask you to obtain an NBI Clearance — we'll reimburse the fee.

Schedule

Full-time, 40 hours per week

Paid twice monthly

Long-term role — we're hiring carefully because we want to grow with the right person



How to apply (please read carefully — incomplete applications will not be reviewed)

In your
, please include all 6 items below. We sort applications by who followed every instruction — not by who applied first.

At the very top of your
, write the word “Buddy” in bold. (This is so we know you read all the way to the end of this post.)

Tell us in 2–3 sentences: are you a dog person? Why?



Record a 1–3 minute video covering the four prompts described below, and get it to us any way you want — attach the file, paste a YouTube unlisted link, Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer, anything that works.



Attach a screenshot of a current speedtest.net result showing your download speed, upload speed, and ping. In the
, also tell us what internet plan you have at home and whether you're on a wired Ethernet connection or WiFi.



List any customer service, e-commerce, admin, or office software / tools you have used (for example: Richpanel, Gorgias, Zendesk, Help Scout, Shopify, WooCommerce, Klaviyo, QuickBooks, Google Workspace — anything you actually know).

List one or more previous employers who can speak to how good your customer service is. The more the better — but one is fine if that's all you have.



Video prompts (1–3 minutes total, single take, no editing)

Please cover all four of the following in your video, in any order you like. There's no script — just talk to us like you'd talk to a customer.



Introduce yourself. Your first name, where you live in the Philippines, and one thing about you that's not on your resume.

Tell us about your customer service background. Where you've worked, who your customers were, and — especially — what your phone customer service experience has been like. What kinds of calls did you handle? How often were you on the phone? What were your callers like?



Why this role? Tell us what you're looking for in your next job and why customer service for US pet owners feels like a fit for you.

What else can you do? Customer service is the main job — but a person with extra skills is gold to a small team like ours. If there's another work skill you have that could help our company (bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, scheduling, etc.), tell us briefly about it. If customer service is your only area, just say so — that's a fine answer.



Tips:

Record in a quiet room. Audio clarity matters more than video quality.

Use your phone or webcam. We want to hear the real you.

1 minute minimum, 3 minutes maximum. Going under or over is a soft red flag — it tells us how you'd manage time on a real call.

If your application is missing any of items 1–6, or if your video is over 5 minutes or under 1 minute, we will not review it. We're being strict because we're hiring carefully — not because we don't respect your time.

title: [GRAVEYARD SHIFT] Property Management & Executive Assistant (Remote - PH)
description:
COMPANY: McCracken Property Management

LOCATION: Remote (Based in the Philippines)

SHIFT SCHEDULE: Thursday through Monday (5 days a week)

HOURS: 6:00 AM - 2:00 PM Pacific Time (PT) or 6:00 AM - 3:00 PM PT (includes a 1-hour lunch break). Note: Weekend shifts may offer flexible or later hours depending on operational requirements.

REPORTS TO: CEO / Founder



ABOUT MCCRACKEN PROPERTY MANAGEMENT



McCracken Property Management handles a premium, diverse portfolio of long-term rentals (LTR), short-term rentals (STR), and multi-unit estates across Oregon and Texas. We are an intentionally lean, high-touch operation currently managing 50 doors, with an aggressive strategy for growth. Because we are a growing boutique firm, our tea
mbers wear multiple hats. We prioritize giving our team desired outcomes rather than micromanaged tasks, using proven leadership methodologies like Dan Martell’s "Buy Back Your Time". We value Integrity, Extreme Ownership, Excellence, and Resourcefulness.



POSITION SUMMARY & TEAM STRUCTURE



We are looking for a highly capable, sharp, and proactive professional based in the Philippines to join us on our critical graveyard shift (Thursday to Monday).



If you are worried about being left on an island—don't be! You are joining an established, supportive ecosystem. You will be an integral part of the team from day one, receiving comprehensive onboarding, training, and documentation. You will have excellent resources at your disposal, working alongside:



A seasoned, full-time VA based in the Philippines who has been with us for several years. They work a noon to 9:00 PM shift, meaning you will have a highly valuable daily schedule overlap on weekdays for collaboration and handoffs.



A dedicated, part-time "boots-on-the-ground" Cleaner Manager/Supervisor to handle physical on-site logistics.



THE WEEKEND DYNAMIC: URGENT TRIAGE + DEEP WORK



The weekend portion of this shift is specifically where we currently lack coverage. Because the rest of the corporate team is offline, your Saturdays and Sundays will be a unique hybrid:



Urgent Triage: Handling real-time guest inquiries, active turnovers, or urgent maintenance coordination as they arise.



Deep Work & Project Time: Once the immediate tasks are controlled, the weekends offer quiet, uninterrupted blocks of time. You will use this space to work on high-value, needle-moving internal projects, such as organizing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and auditing systems to help us scale.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



SHORT-TERM RENTAL (STR) SUPPORT & GUEST COORDINATION



Rapid Guest Communication: Manage inquiries and active guest communication inside OwnerRez, maintaining a sub-1-hour response time standard during your shift.



Reservation Lifecycle Management: Audit new bookings, verify legal documentation (Renter Agreements), ensure digital door access codes generate correctly, and cross-verify booking readiness in Breezeway.



Cleaner Coordination: Monitor real-time turnover schedules in Breezeway and communicate seamlessly with our on-the-ground Cleaner Supervisor when physical intervention is needed.



Issue and Damage Triage: Log cleaner-reported damages into Google Drive and the Claims Tracker, handling automated AirCover claims or coordinating with Waivo protection systems.



LONG-TERM RENTAL (LTR) ADMINISTRATION



Lead & Marketing Oversight: Input and organize property owner leads inside LeadSimple. Use tools like RentVine to update property descriptions, rental rates, and sync listings to syndication channels.



Applicant Screening Coordination: Coordinate daily verification procedures, including sending income verification requests to employers and verifying tenant details.



System Controls & Logs: Set up portfolios/owners in RentVine, process application configurations, and document centralized maintenance notes internally to maintain total visibility for the weekday staff.



EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT TO THE CEO



Calendar Management: Protect the CEO's time by plotting and maintaining detailed calendar appointments, accounting for multi-state time zones (Pacific and Central).



The 1-3-1 Critical Thinking Protocol: Bring challenges to the CEO using the 1-3-1 Method (1 clearly defined problem, 3 researched potential solutions, and 1 final recommendation with strong logic).



System & SOP Organization: Use your weekend quiet hours to audit, refine, and organize company SOPs to ensure our operations remain scalable as we grow past 50 doors.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS



Graveyard Shift Reliability: Proven track record of working stable, high-performance graveyard shifts without disruptions.



Tech-Savvy Adaptability: Experience (or quick mastery) with property management software tools like OwnerRez, RentVine, Breezeway, LeadSimple, Slack, OpenPhone, and Google Workspace.



Impeccable Communication: Near-native written and spoken English skills, with the ability to maintain a warm yet highly professional tone under pressure.



Proactive Problem Solving: A mind for details and "extreme ownership". You don't just wait to be told what to do; you look for gaps and plug them.



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



High-speed, stable internet connection with a backup solution (power/internet).



A quiet, distraction-free workspace.



A modern laptop or desktop computer capable of running multiple SaaS applications simultaneously.



HOW TO APPLY:



If you are ready to take extreme ownership of this role, enjoy the balance of fast-paced coordination and quiet project focus, and want to grow alongside a dynamic property management company, we want to hear from you!



Please submit your application, resume, and background details by filling out our official application form here:



APPLY HERE VIA OUR GOOGLE FORM:

Hi! I’m Sofi, a content creator and videographer currently growing my YouTube channel focused on camera gear, creative workflows, and occasional lifestyle/vlog content.



I’m looking for a freelance video editor to grow with long-term as the channel evolves.



At the 
nt, I’m primarily creating:

- Gear review videos

- Sit-down talking head videos

- Occasional vlogs



My editing style is clean, modern, engaging, and retention-focused without being overly flashy or chaotic.

This is a great role for someone with strong communication skills, good instincts, attention to detail, and an interest in growing with a creator over time. You do NOT need years of YouTube experience or advanced VFX skills.



What You'll Be Editing



- YouTube videos typically ranging from 4–12 minutes

- Mostly talking-head footage paired with B-roll

- Light motion graphics

- Basic sound design and music

- Simple transitions and pacing improvements



I will usually provide:



- Talking footage

- B-roll footage

- Scripts or outlines

- Notes and creative direction

- Access to my Envato Elements account for music, sound effects, and templates



What I’m Looking For



- Strong communication and responsiveness

- Good pacing instincts

- Attention to detail

- Willingness to learn and adapt to feedback

- Organized workflow

- Ability to follow direction closely

- Someone reliable and easy to work with long-term



You do NOT need:

Advanced animation skills

Heavy color grading skills

Extensive YouTube experience



Editing Workflow



My current workflow will usually look like this:



I send footage, script, and notes

You create a rough cut

I leave revision notes in 

Final revisions are completed



At first, I’ll likely provide fairly detailed direction while we develop a workflow together. Over time, I’d love for the editor to become more independent with pacing, B-roll placement, and light creative decisions.





Communication is very important to me

I mainly communicate through chat (Slack preferred)

I do not expect 24/7 availability

I do expect regular communication and updates, especially during active projects



We’ll likely check in 1–3 times per day while working on a video



DaVinci Resolve preferred, but not required

Other editing software is completely fine if your workflow is strong

No caption/subtitle work required

I will personally handle color grading when needed



Volume & Turnaround



Starting with approximately 4 videos per month

Rough cuts are ideally delivered within 2–4 days depending on project complexity

Revision turnaround is ideally within 1–2 days

title: BIM Coordinator – Fire Alarm & Low Voltage Systems
description:
ABOUT US

Industrial Electronic Systems, Inc. (IES) is a U.S.-based fire alarm and life safety company serving commercial clients across Northern California. We design, install, and integrate fire alarm and low voltage systems for real construction projects — hospitals, office buildings, warehouses, and more.

We're a small, technical team and we take our work seriously. When you work with IES, your drawings go straight into active construction projects.



THE ENGAGEMENT

We're looking for a full-time independent contractor to provide Remote BIM Coordination support to our U.S. engineering team on an ongoing basis. The core of this contract is BIM coordination and clash detection — you'll be working inside live Revit models, identifying and resolving clashes between fire alarm/low voltage systems and other trades (mechanical, structural, electrical).

This is a hands-on technical contract. Deliverables go directly into active U.S. commercial construction projects.



SCOPE OF WORK

BIM Coordination (Primary Focus)



Run clash detection between MEP, fire alarm, and structural models

Resolve clashes and coordinate solutions with the IES engineering team

Maintain and update Revit models for fire alarm and low voltage systems

Produce coordination drawings and clash reports for project teams



CAD Drafting & Documentation



Draft 2D construction drawings in AutoCAD — device layouts, riser diagrams, wiring details, and submittal sets

Set up sheets, title blocks, viewports, layers, and XREFs to IES standards

Update drawings based on field markups and design changes



Design Support



Assist with NFPA-compliant fire alarm device layout (spacing, coverage, strobe placement)

Support design of access control, intrusion, and structured cabling systems

Review architectural and electrical drawings to catch coordination issues early



Research & Problem Solving



Research NFPA 72, NEC, and local AHJ code requirements

Flag missing information in plans before they turn into RFIs

Document findings clearly and communicate impacts to the IES engineering team

title: Real Estate Data Manager (YOU MUST SPEAK FLUENT ENGLISH)
description:
* YOU MUST SPEAK FLUENT ENGLISH *

We're a US-based virtual real estate company looking for a detail-oriented Data Manager to run our daily lead pipeline. Every morning you'll pull fresh distress lists from county sources, scrub the data, run skip tracing and phone verification, then import clean, dial-ready leads into our CRM before our acquisitions team starts calling.



The work is consistent, structured, and rewards accuracy. If you're the kind of person who notices a misspelled column header and fixes it without being asked — keep reading.



This is a long-term role. We want someone who will own this pipeline for years, not weeks.





Schedule

- Hours: 40 hours per week

- Days: Monday through Friday

- Time zone: 9am-6pm (CST)

- Deadline: All daily lists must be live in our CRM daily.



Pay

- $4–6 USD/hour depending on experience

- Paid bi-weekly via Payoneer or PayPal

- Performance bonus for clean data quality and on-time delivery

- Raise review at 90 days



What You'll Do Every Day:

1. Pull distress lists from county government portals: probate, auction, tax delinquent, pre-foreclosure, and auction.

2. Scrub the data in Google Sheets — dedupe by APN, standardize addresses to USPS format, remove vacant land, cross-check against our CRM.

3. Organize each list into our standard 14-column upload format

4. Run the cleaned list through BatchLeads for skip tracing

5. Verify every phone number through Trestle (activity score, line type, connection status)

6. Reorder phones so the highest-scored number lands in Phone 1

7. Import the final file into FreedomSoft with the correct campaign tag and pipeline stage

8. Log every step in our Master Tracker (raw count, scrubbed count, hit rate, etc.)



A full Standard Operating Procedure with screenshots and a worked example will be provided. You will not be figuring this out from scratch.



Tools You'll Use:

- Google Sheets (heavy daily use — formulas, filters, dedupe, VLOOKUP)

- FreedomSoft (our CRM — we'll train you)

- XLeads (skip tracing)

- Trestle (phone verification)

- County government websites (varies by list type)

- Slack (daily check-ins and questions)



What We Need From You:

- Strong Google Sheets skills — you should be comfortable with formulas, filters, dedupe, and conditional formatting

- Sharp attention to detail — bad data costs us real money

- Comfortable navigating unfamiliar government websites and exporting CSVs

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace

- Good written English for daily Slack updates

- Available Mon–Fri without exception (this is a daily pipeline — one missed day backs up the whole team)

- Able to start As Soon As Possible



Bonus Points If You Have:

- Prior US real estate experience

- Experience with FreedomSoft, BatchLeads, PropStream, or any real estate CRM

- Background in data entry, list management, or data cleaning roles

- Skip tracing experience (Xleads, Skip Genie, IDI, TLO, etc.)

- Familiarity with US county records systems



What Makes This Role Different:

- Structured, repeatable work. This is not a "wear many hats" VA role. You'll do the same workflow every day and get faster at it every week.

- Clear ownership. You own the pipeline. Your numbers (hit rate, dead phone rate, on-time delivery) are visible to the team every Friday.

- Long-term growth. As we scale, you'll have the chance to train other VAs on this workflow and move into a team lead role.

You won't be making cold calls. This is back-office data work. We have a separate Acquisitions Team for outreach.



How to Apply

1. Include the word PIPELINE at the top of your application. Applications without this word will be deleted unread.

2. Briefly describe one time you cleaned a messy data set: what was wrong with it, how you fixed it, and how long it took.

3. Tell me what daily hours you would work in Philippine time.

We will respond to the strongest applicants within 3 business days.



Thank you for reading the full post. We're looking forward to building a long-term team with the right person.

Alongside this, you may also provide support to the property management team where required, including assisting with maintenance administration, compliance-related tasks, certificate renewals, contractor coordination and general customer service support across our managed properties.



About Freeman Real Estate:



Freeman Real Estate is a specialist lettings agency operating within the supported housing and care sector.



We work closely with landlords, housing providers and care organisations across the Midlands to help facilitate long-term housing solutions for people in need of support or care.



Our role is to onboard and manage landlords’ properties whilst facilitating long-term lease agreements with housing providers. We act as a central point of coordination between landlords, housing providers and contractors to help ensure properties are managed professionally and relationships are maintained effectively throughout each lease.



Key Responsibilities:



• Generate, process and upload invoices, supplier invoices, statements and financial records accurately within company systems



• Log and reconcile rental payments, disbursements and contractor payments



• Follow up on outstanding invoices, rental payments and contractor payments where required

• Support with tenancy setup administration and any related documentation required throughout the setup process



• Maintain organised records, documents and compliance information across the business



• Assist the property management team with maintenance administration, contractor coordination and certificate renewals where required



• Support general customer service enquiries and day-to-day operational administration across the business



• Work closely with the directors and wider team to help maintain organised systems, accurate records and efficient day-to-day operations across the business



What We’re Looking For:



We are looking for someone who is highly organised, proactive and comfortable supporting the day-to-day operations of an expanding business.



A successful candidate will have strong attention to detail, excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage administrative responsibilities accurately and consistently across multiple areas of the business.



You should be comfortable working independently, managing your workload effectively and communicating professionally with landlords, housing providers, contractors and the wider team where required.



The ideal candidate will have:



• Strong organisational and time management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Confidence using systems, software and online platforms

• The ability to manage multiple administrative tasks efficiently

• A willingness to learn, develop and grow within the business



Previous experience in administration, operations, finance support, property administration or customer service would be beneficial, but is not essential for the right candidate.



A typical day in this role may include:



• Processing finance administration tasks and helping ensure all records and payments remain up to date



• Supporting the directors and wider team with day-to-day operational and administrative tasks



• Communicating with landlords, housing providers, contractors and customers via
 and phone

• Supporting the property management team with maintenance administration and general operational support



• Managing priorities across multiple ongoing properties, tenancies and operational tasks



• Helping maintain organised systems, accurate records and efficient day-to-day business operations



Working Setup & Hours:



• Full-time remote position

• Monday to Friday

• Working hours aligned with UK business hours (9:00am – 5:30pm UK time)

High-performing tea
mbers who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have the opportunity to progress into leadership roles and eventually help manage the offshore team.

Essential Requirements

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

Highly Regarded

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience working with Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or tea
ntoring experience

title: Helpdesk Agent — Full-Time | Remote
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a sharp, reliable Helpdesk Agent to join our remote MSP support team as our first line of triage. This role is the front door of our service desk — your job is to answer the phone, log tickets, gather the right information, resolve what you can, and get everything else into the hands of the right engineer fast. You don't need years of IT experience. You need to be organised, calm under pressure, a clear communicator, and genuinely interested in IT. We'll train you on our tools and processes. You'll work in a structured, ticket-driven environment with clear SOPs and senior engineers to escalate to.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Triage & Ticket Intake (60%)





Answer inbound client calls,
s, and ticket submissions as the first point of contact

Log every request in HaloPSA with clear, complete information — who, what, when, impact, urgency

Ask the right diagnostic questions to capture what an engineer needs to resolve the issue

Categorise, prioritise, and route tickets to the correct engineer or queue

Set client expectations on response and resolution times

Keep clients updated on ticket progress and chase internal owners when tickets stall





Basic Issue Resolution (20%)





Resolve simple, well-documented issues within your scope — password resets, account unlocks, licence assignment, basic M365 questions, MFA resets, printer issues

Follow runbooks and SOPs step-by-step

Escalate anything outside your scope quickly rather than getting stuck





Ticket Hygiene & Documentation (10%)





Keep tickets clean — accurate time entries, clear notes, correct status

Flag tickets that have been sitting too long or are missing information

Help maintain the knowledge base by documenting common questions and fixes





Monitoring & Alert Triage (10%)





Watch incoming monitoring alerts from our RMM and security tools

Action what's documented; escalate the rest

Spot patterns — repeated alerts, unusual activity — and flag to senior staff



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



6+ months in a customer service, call centre, helpdesk, or IT support role (any environment)

Basic working knowledge of:



Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive — from a user perspective is fine)

Windows 10/11 desktop basics

General understanding of how the internet,
, and computers work





Excellent written English and near-native spoken English — you'll be on the phone with Australian clients daily

Calm, friendly, and professional phone manner

Highly organised — you don't lose tickets, miss callbacks, or forget to update notes

Genuinely curious about IT and keen to learn

Comfortable following process and asking for help when unsure



HIGHLY VALUED (NOT REQUIRED)



Any exposure to a ticketing system (HaloPSA, ConnectWise, Zendesk, Freshdesk, etc.)

IT-related study, certifications (MS-900, CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, etc.), or self-taught lab experience

Previous MSP or IT services environment

Manufacturing or wholesale industry client exposure



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Salary: ?40,000 – ?60,000/month depending on experience, paid twice monthly

Hours: 37.5 hours per week. Shifts are scheduled between 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM Sydney (AEDT/AEST) time

Public Holidays: Australian public holidays observed and paid from day one



The following benefits apply after successful completion of the 3-month probationary period:



Annual Leave: 4 weeks fully paid leave per calendar year



3 weeks during the Christmas/New Year shutdown (aligned to Australian holidays)

5 days at your discretion with prior approval





HMO Allowance: Provided annually — you arrange your own HMO policy



REQUIREMENTS



Stable, high-speed internet with low latency

Quiet, professional workspace for client calls

Available during Australian business hours

Able to pass a basic aptitude and communication assessment during the hiring process



TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE:



A brief intro message — tell us why you want to get into IT support

A short video (60–90 seconds) introducing yourself, telling us about your customer service or IT support experience, and why you'd be a good fit for this role. Phone camera is OK, just make sure we can clearly hear you.

Your available working hours

Confirmation you're comfortable completing a short assessment

ABOUT US: 

FitLeads is an Australian-based marketing agency exclusively serving gyms and fitness studios across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and Canada. We run paid Meta/Instagram ads for 100's of active gym clients and now we're building out our own organic Instagram presence to grow the FitLeads brand.

We're a lean, fast moving team. No corporate nonsense. We move quickly, we test things, and we reward people who take ownership.



THE ROLE: 

We're looking for a Social Media Growth Specialist to own our organic Instagram strategy end to end.

This is not a "post pretty graphics" role. This is a strategic growth role. You'll be responsible for building a content and engagement system that actually grows followers, drives profile visits, and turns attention into inbound leads for our agency.

You'll work directly with the founder and have real input into what we build.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Develop and execute an organic Instagram growth strategy (content pillars, posting cadence, hashtag/ engagement tactics)

Plan and manage the content calendar coordinating video content, carousels, and static posts

Write captions and hooks that are sharp, punchy, and built to stop the scroll

Engage with our audience and target accounts in a way that builds community (not spam)

Track performance weekly and report on what's working, what's not, and what we're doing about it

Stay on top of Instagram algorithm changes and adapt the strategy accordingly



YOU'RE THE RIGHT PERSON IF...



You've grown an Instagram account from scratch (or significantly grown one) and you can prove it

You understand the difference between vanity metrics and actual growth

You write well in English and can match a brand's voice

You're proactive, you don't wait to be told what to do next

You're comfortable with data and can back up your decisions with numbers

You have a point of view on what works on Instagram right now, and you can defend it



YOU'RE NOT THE RIGHT PERSON IF...



Your experience is mainly running paid ads (we already have that covered)

You only know how to schedule posts and report follower counts

You need step by step direction to produce work

You've never personally grown a page or account organically



HOW TO APPLY

Send a message with all three of the following. Applications missing any of these will not be considered (And we wont contact you)



Proof of results, Links to Instagram accounts you've grown organically. Tell us the starting follower count, the timeframe, and the result. Screenshots of growth analytics are a bonus.

Your take on organic IG growth:  In 3-5 sentences, what's the most important thing a B2B brand needs to do right now to grow organically on Instagram?

Your availability and rate: Confirm you're available for approx. 10 hours per week and include your expected hourly rate in PHP.
